messages:
sam.w: Heads-up — after last night's OFED + IB firmware roll in eu-west-1 we've seen NCCL all-reduce bandwidth drop ~60% on p4d clusters and intermittent NCCL timeouts in distributed training. Any visibility?

nisha.k: Can you paste job ids / perf numbers? Is this only eu-west?

sam.w: Job ids: train-2204, train-2207. Baseline allreduce @ 40GB/s, now 15–18GB/s. Errors like: 
```
NCCL WARN Call to MPI_Send failed: Timeout
NCCL WARN NCCL_P2P_TIMEOUT: p2p firehose timeout
```

raj.v: We rolled OFED 5.1.0 -> 5.2.0 and Mellanox firmware 14.26 -> 14.28 overnight via image update. Affected nodes show mlx5_core versions: 
```
modinfo mlx5_core | grep version
version: 5.2.0-OFED
```

raj.v: ibstat looks ok but link speeds report 100Gb/s, not 200Gb/s on a subset: 
```
LinkLayer: InfiniBand
Port1: 100Gb/s
```

kevin.t: Seeing similar in test cluster. Suggest check `ethtool -i` on ib0 and `dmesg | grep mlx5` — I got this on one host: 
```
mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: firmware 14.28.0: set HCA PKEY failed
mlx5_core: CQ moderation mismatch
```

maya.p: Quick try: I set `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` on a failing job and bandwidth jumped to ~30GB/s (still shy of baseline). So p2p via IB transport is the issue. 

nisha.k: Is nv_peer_mem loaded? `lsmod | grep nv_peer_mem` 

raj.v: Yes: `nv_peer_mem 16384 2 rdma_cm` 

kevin.t: Also try forcing NCCL to use the TCP fallback: `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0` — we saw similar pattern when kernel vs OFED ABI mismatched. If that's the case the quickest mitigation is to revert OFED/firmware image in eu-west and re-run. 

sam.w: Can we rollback in a controlled way? How big is the blast? 

infra-oncall-bot: Automated deploy report: OFED/firmware image roll eu-west-1 started 2024-06-05T03:12Z, 84 nodes updated. No automatic rollback scheduled. 

maya.p: We should only rollback the p4d pool (32 nodes) first. Can ops spin up new instances from previous AMI and drain the updated ones? 

raj.v: Confirmed: nodes provisioned from image ami-20240523 (old) had OFED 5.1 and show normal NCCL metrics. New image ami-20240602 (current) has OFED 5.2 and degraded metrics. 

kevin.t: Kernel mismatch note: some hosts were on kernel 6.1.0-rc and OFED build targeted 5.x — that creates ABI/driver mismatches for mlx5. Check `uname -r`. 

nisha.k: Ok ops: schedule rollback for p4d eu-west pool at 12:00 UTC. We'll drain, reprovision from ami-20240523, validate perf with a short allreduce benchmark, then scale back. 

sam.w: Also file postmortem. Root candidate: OFED/firmware pairing + kernel/driver ABI change breaking Mellanox transport for NCCL. Need better rollout gating (perf smoke tests) and region-specific canaries. 

maya.p: For short-term, set cluster-level env `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` for training queues to reduce failures while rollback is in progress. 

kevin.t: Add to checklist: verify `rdma-core` versions, `mlx5_core` module version, `ethtool -S ib0 | grep rx_cq_overflow` and ensure firmware shim compatibility. 

sam.w: Thanks — will track on infra playbook. Will update when rollback complete. :thumbsup:
